title: Auckland · Coromandel Peninsula Loop
slogan: A 295 km loop out of Thames fuel
story: Sea, forest and tight Kiwi touring roads. 295 km round from Thames - plan on about 5 h 06 of riding. On the way it passes Coromandel town, Whitianga beach and Kauaeranga valley. It keeps close to the shore for long stretches.
